outgoing.name: Crust (geology)
outgoing.excerpt: Rhenium is widely spread through the Earth's crust at approximately 0.001 ppm.

outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: It is generally considered to have been discovered by Walter Noddack, Ida Tacke, and Otto Berg in Germany.

outgoing.name: Latin
outgoing.excerpt: Rhenium (Latin Rhenus meaning "Rhine") was the last naturally-occurring element to be discovered.
